People: Edgar Allan Poe (author, Wikidata Q16867), died 1849; Félix Rabbe (translator, Wikidata Q18115775), died 1900. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Poe, Edgar Allan, 1809-1849; Rabbe, Félix, 1840?-1900 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Poe_-_Derniers_Contes.djvu, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/commons:fr:Poe - Derniers Contes.djvu. The scan does not show the credit of Félix Rabbe, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
